        ### Options

CHAIN: "Stroma is supportive tissue" -> "does not produce hormones" -> "corpus albicans is a scar tissue" -> "formed after corpus luteum regression" -> "not involved in progesterone production" -> 85%
CHAIN: "Mature follicles are involved in ovulation" -> "but do not produce progesterone" -> "progesterone is produced by corpus luteum" -> "after ovulation occurs" -> 90%
